jobs.occupation: People Operations Administrator at reMarkable
jobs.description:
1 year parental leave cover

About the role
Join a dynamic and evolving organization dedicated to enhancing employee experiences and operational efficiency. On our global journey, we’re looking for a People Operation Administrator who can join us for one year, playing a pivotal role in our payroll processes and employee support systems.

The People Operations Administrator will serve as a subject matter expert on payroll while assisting employees across the organization. This role is critical to ensuring accurate salary management and sharing information effectively, contributing directly to our company’s goals of operational excellence and employee satisfaction.

Your areas of responsibility will include
• 
Payroll management: Manage accurate, compliant payroll cycles in three countries while partnering closely with finance and external providers. Act as the trusted primary contact for payroll-related inquiries. Support the rollout of our new payroll partner.

• 
Systems & process optimization: Drive efficiencies and continuously seek opportunities to improve our processes, systems and workflows

• 
Benefits management: Partner with external vendors to make sure our benefits are up to date and communicated to our employees across three countries

• 
Data management & monitoring: Maintain reliable employee data and tracking (for such things as overtime, sick leave, and parental leave) to support audits and reporting.

• 
Operational support: Provide operational support within HR, maintain HR systems, and handle personnel administration tasks.

• 
Collaboration & employee engagement: Partner with the People team and internal stakeholders to implement employee initiatives and enhance overall work life experience

We are looking for the following experience
• 
Minimum 1 year of experience with payroll; international payroll experience is a plus.

• 
Familiarity with HR practices beyond payroll

• 
Prior experience in HR systems, with a knack for system optimization

• 
Analytical, detail oriented and problem-solving skills, it helps to enjoy working with numbers

• 
You bring new ideas to the table, seeking efficient ways to optimize processes

• 
Great collaboration skills, being able to adapt quickly to changes and prioritize tasks amid unexpected challenges

What you can learn and experience!
• 
Deepen your knowledge of Norwegian, UK and US payroll

• 
Learn from the team and gain hands-on experience with global payroll

• 
Be an important support in the rollout of a new global payroll partner

• 
Partner closely with the Finance team, legal team and systems team

• 
Be a part of a supportive and highly functioning team of professionals with deep knowledge of diverse fields, with a culture of knowledge sharing and curiosity

Why we enjoy working here
• 
Encouragement to learn and grow in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, learning, and modern technology

• 
A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company

• 
5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation

• 
Premium health insurance and travel insurance

• 
Access to a free employee gym with top equipment

• 
A flexible hybrid work model

• 
Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative

• 
Phone, phone subscription and home broadband coverage

• 
Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings

If you're ready to make an impact in a role that combines payroll expertise with operational innovation, we’d love to hear from you!

Practical information
• 
Type of employment: Temporary (1 year maternity leave cover)

• 
We will consider applications on a rolling basis

• 
Language requirements: English and Norwegian

• 
Location: Oslo, Norway

• 
Visa requirements: Norwegian work visa is required

jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller at reMarkable
jobs.description:
reMarkable makes paper tablets for people who think better on paper. Founded in Oslo in 2013, we’ve created a category of our own: distraction-free devices that combine the feel of pen on paper with the power of digital tools. Our products are used by people all over the world to think, focus and do their best work. We design our hardware, software and services in-house, and we’re a focused, high-ownership team where every role has a direct impact on the product and our customers.

As a Senior Financial Controller at reMarkable, you will play a central role in driving high financial integrity, optimizing group accounting processes, and supporting our global scale across hardware, software, and services. You’ll join a collaborative, high-ownership team where your work directly impacts financial strategy, operational excellence, and decision-making.

Your areas of responsibility will include

Oversee group financial controlling, monthly closing processes, and financial reporting.

• 
Ensure compliance with accounting standards (IFRS/NGAAP) and internal financial controls.

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial systems, forecasting, and budgeting.

• 
Manage audit processes and act as a key contact for external auditors and advisors.

• 
Drive continuous process optimization within accounting, inventory, and supply chain finance.

We are looking for the following experience
• 
Experience in financial controlling, audit, or senior accounting roles.

• 
Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Auditing, or Business Administration.

Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP reporting standards.

jobs.occupation: Shape Quality for Next-Generation AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose)
We are seeking a QA Manager to help establish and maintain the quality and document-control framework supporting Nordscale’s mission-critical data centre operations. As Nordscale is building its operating organisation, you will have the opportunity to shape practical quality processes, controlled documentation and ways of working from an early stage.

You will ensure that operational and technical information is controlled, traceable, approved, accessible and audit-ready, while helping the organisation identify and implement the quality management arrangements required by applicable customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, the Process Specialist and other technical functions, you will provide quality governance around procedures, records, changes and non-conformities. Technical and operational owners remain accountable for technical content, approvals and corrective work.
What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities)
• Help establish and continuously improve the quality and document-control framework across operations, maintenance, engineering and compliance.
• Manage controlled documents throughout their lifecycle, from creation and approval to publication and archiving.
• Maintain document registers, standards and traceability across controlled information.
• Govern document control for SOPs, MOPs, EOPs and technical work instructions.
• Coordinate audit readiness and ensure relevant evidence and records are available and traceable.
• Define and maintain the requirements and processes for managing non-conformities and corrective actions.
• Ensure operational changes are documented, approved and reflected in controlled documentation.
• Monitor quality and compliance trends to identify areas for improvement.
• Work with Operations and Engineering to embed practical quality controls.About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)
You may come from quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance in data centres, energy, oil and gas, industrial plants, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or another technically complex and audited environment.

You combine strong structure and attention to detail with enough technical understanding to work credibly with engineering and operations teams. You are comfortable helping to build fit-for-purpose quality processes in an organisation that is still developing its systems and ways of working.
Key Characteristics
• Structured and rigorous, with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
• Comfortable challenging gaps in process or evidence while working constructively with operational teams.
• Collaborative and pragmatic, able to translate quality requirements into workable practices.
• Analytical and improvement-oriented, using findings and trends to prevent recurrence.Skills & Qualifications
• Relevant experience in quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance within a technical or regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of document control, revision management, traceability, compliance and audit requirements.
• Experience establishing, implementing or improving practical quality processes and controlled documentation.
• Good digital skills and experience with electronic document or quality management systems.
• Strong interest in exploring and applying LLMs to improve workflows, processes and quality.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik.Nice to Have
• Experience from data centres or other mission-critical infrastructure.
• Experience supporting ISO 9001 or comparable management systems; exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 is also relevant.
• Experience with SOP, MOP and EOP governance in live technical operations.
• Experience from engineering, maintenance or asset-management environments and the handover of as-built, O&M or commissioning documentation.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian.What We Can Offer You
• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
• The opportunity to shape the quality framework and operating standards of a growing AI infrastructure environment.
• A cross-functional role with close exposure to Operations, Engineering and technical specialists.
• Relocation support assessed individually, if required.Equal Opportunities Statement
We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
Application and Contact
Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

jobs.occupation: Build the Future of AI Infrastructure in Northern Norway
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose) 

We are seeking an Operational Process Specialist to strengthen the performance, resilience and continuous improvement of mechanical, electrical and process systems in a mission-critical data centre environment. 

In this role, you will take ownership of operational procedures and help ensure they reflect the technical environment, operational best practice, and the way work is carried out in practice. You will work closely with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to improve processes and support safe, efficient and reliable operations. 

This is an opportunity to help shape the procedures and technical standards behind a growing AI infrastructure environment, with broad exposure across disciplines and a clear impact on day-to-day operations. 

 

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities) 

• Analyse and optimise the performance of mechanical, electrical and process systems. 
• Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, resilience and operational performance. 
• Own the technical and operational content of procedures and support their implementation in day-to-day operations. 
• Develop and improve the technical content of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) and work instructions together with relevant specialists. 
• Collaborate with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to ensure critical infrastructure operates safely, efficiently and within design parameters. 
• Support change management by assessing operational impacts and validating process changes before implementation. 
• Review operational data, completed work, deviations and current practices to identify improvement opportunities. 
• Provide technical input to audits, compliance activities and continuous improvement programmes. 
About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience) 

You may currently be working in technical operations, facilities, maintenance, process improvement or engineering support, with experience from data centres or another technically complex environment such as industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals or manufacturing. 

You have broad technical understanding and enjoy working across disciplines, understanding how systems interact and finding practical ways to improve their operation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline. What matters is that you see the bigger picture, work effectively with technical specialists and take a structured approach to processes, quality and documentation. 

 

Key Characteristics 

• Passionate about operational excellence and continuous improvement. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach. 
• Calm under pressure and able to make informed decisions within mission-critical environments. 
• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. 
• Collaborative and able to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams. 
• Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high operational standards. 
• Safety-focused with a strong understanding of critical infrastructure risk management. 
Skills & Qualifications 

• Relevant experience operating, maintaining or optimising mechanical, electrical or process systems. 
• Broad technical understanding and the ability to see how different systems interact. 
• Experience from technical environments where reliability and operational continuity are critical. 
• Experience developing or improving operational procedures and technical work instructions. 
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik. 
Nice to Have 

• Experience with SOPs, MOPs, EOPs or similar operational procedures. 
• Experience with process optimisation, continuous improvement or monitoring/BMS systems. 
• Experience from data centres, industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or similar technically complex environments. 
• Relevant technical education or qualifications; equivalent practical experience is also valued. 
What We Can Offer You
